knowledge_document.content: /goal make sure that data harness is where all your knowledge and brain, your whole /home/amdy/.gemini folder should be cloned in real time inside the data_rein on the home folder, reorganizing your folder structure to ensure maximum rag optimization for all types of AIs, including you (antigravity-cli or agy), odysseus ai, hermes, and all present and future local models. condensate all the knowledge present in the /home/amdy/data_rein/knowledge_base/docs folder and in your /home/amdy/.gemini/ folder in on well strctured folder. it should contain all my current projects, but you should organize all the text files to best optimize tokens input and output based on the capabilities of the model. you should also create a folder where there will be stored prompts. you should create and agent with the skill to optimize my prompts. this agent must be able to be integrated on the future to run on local hardware, so the maximum context windows it will have is +- 16k tokens. in the future, this agent will be intercepting my prompts, to optimize for use on local models. i will be using my local models to an diverse array of functions and usecases, generating text, code, images, audio, and much more. all my local and remote models will be trained on local data. i want to create a data extraction pipeline on my system, distributing the load between amdy and tell. this pipeline should be able to support data extraction from the 10 most popular text, image and audio formats, and should be able to scale to add support to more in the future. in the future i want to locally train my models on the data extracted from this pipeline. this project must use the PON programming paradigm as its main director. you will be using python for this project.
